faqs.question: How do I book a tour?
faqs.answer: Choose an experience and send a booking request with your preferred date and group details. Our team will confirm availability, pickup and the final arrangement with you.

faqs.question: Is my booking confirmed immediately?
faqs.answer: No. The website sends a booking request first. Your booking is confirmed after our team checks availability and sends you the final details.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay online?
faqs.answer: No online payment is required when sending a request. Our team will explain the available payment options when confirming your booking.

faqs.question: Do you provide hotel pickup?
faqs.answer: Pickup depends on the tour and your hotel location. Add your hotel or area to the booking request and we will confirm the pickup point and time.

faqs.question: Are tours suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Many experiences are family-friendly, but suitability can depend on age, sea conditions and the activity. Tell us the children’s ages so we can recommend the right option.

faqs.question: Can I change my travel date?
faqs.answer: Contact us as early as possible. Date changes depend on availability, but our team will always try to help you find a suitable alternative.

faqs.question: What happens if the weather is not suitable?
faqs.answer: Safety comes first. If conditions affect an ocean or outdoor experience, our team will discuss rescheduling or another suitable arrangement with you.

faqs.question: Can you customise a Tanzania safari?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your dates, number of travellers, preferred parks and travel style. We can help shape a safari itinerary around your plans.
